files.src/payments/charge-card.ts: Charges customer credit and debit cards through the Stripe API, creates payment intents, and records successful transaction identifiers on the order.
files.src/payments/payment-failures.ts: Handles declined and failed card payments: classifies Stripe decline codes, schedules retry attempts, and notifies customers to update their payment method.
files.src/payments/refunds.ts: Issues full and partial refunds for captured payments and reverses the related ledger entries.
files.src/payments/invoices.ts: Generates invoices for completed orders, calculates taxes and totals, and renders invoice PDFs for customers.
files.src/auth/login.ts: Authenticates users with email and password, verifies bcrypt password hashes, and creates login sessions.
files.src/auth/session-store.ts: Stores, refreshes and expires user session tokens in Redis and revokes sessions on logout.
files.src/auth/password-reset.ts: Sends password reset emails with signed one-time tokens and updates the user's password after verification.
files.src/auth/oauth.ts: Implements Google and GitHub OAuth sign-in, exchanging authorization codes for access tokens and linking external accounts.
files.src/auth/permissions.ts: Checks role-based access control permissions to decide whether a user may perform admin actions.
files.src/inventory/stock-levels.ts: Tracks warehouse stock levels per product SKU and decrements available quantity when orders are placed.
files.src/inventory/reorder.ts: Detects products below their reorder threshold and creates purchase orders with suppliers to restock inventory.
files.src/inventory/reservations.ts: Reserves inventory for items in shopping carts and releases expired reservations back to available stock.
files.src/inventory/warehouse-transfer.ts: Moves stock between warehouses and records transfer shipments and receipts.
files.src/logging/logger.ts: Configures the structured JSON application logger with log levels, timestamps and request correlation IDs.
files.src/logging/audit-log.ts: Writes tamper-evident audit log entries for security-sensitive actions such as permission changes and logins.
files.src/logging/error-reporting.ts: Captures unhandled exceptions and sends error reports with stack traces to the monitoring service.
files.src/logging/log-rotation.ts: Rotates and compresses log files daily and deletes archives older than the retention period.
files.src/catalog/products.ts: Defines the product catalog model with names, descriptions, prices and category lookups.
files.src/catalog/search-index.ts: Builds a full-text search index of product names for the storefront search box.
files.src/shipping/rates.ts: Calculates shipping rates by weight and destination using carrier rate tables.
files.src/shipping/labels.ts: Purchases carrier shipping labels and stores tracking numbers for dispatched orders.
files.src/notifications/email.ts: Sends transactional emails through the SMTP provider using HTML templates.
files.src/notifications/sms.ts: Sends SMS text message notifications for order status updates via Twilio.
files.src/orders/checkout.ts: Coordinates checkout: validates the cart, reserves inventory, charges payment and creates the order.
files.src/orders/order-status.ts: Manages order lifecycle states from pending to shipped, delivered or cancelled.
files.src/config/env.ts: Loads and validates application configuration settings from environment variables at startup.
files.src/db/migrations.ts: Runs ordered SQL schema migrations against the PostgreSQL database.
files.src/api/router.ts: Registers HTTP routes and middleware for the REST API server.
files.src/utils/dates.ts: Formats and parses dates and time zones for display.
files.src/utils/currency.ts: Formats money amounts and converts between currencies using exchange rates.
